english.title: Obstruct / interfere with the proper use of or a person in the execution of their duty at Stansted Airport London
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) intentionally obstructed or interfered with

(A)_[the proper use]_
(B)_[a person acting in the execution of his duty in relation to the operation]_
(C)_[a person acting in the execution of her duty in relation to the operation]_

of Stansted Airport London
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 3(19) and 2(3) of the Stansted Airport - London Byelaws, 1996 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
intentionally obstruct / interfere
with the proper use of Stansted Airport OR
a person acting in the execution of their duty
in relation to the operation of Stansted Airport London
